label: Diagram 3.3
caption: Diagram 3.3 | External protection to protected stairways External escape stairs
description: The drawing is a section titled "Configurations of stairs and external wall", with "See para 3.29" at the top left. A legend on the right shows three symbols: a dark green square for "Fire resisting construction of adjacent building enclosure", a light green square for "Fire resisting construction of protected stairway", and a white square for "Non-fire resisting construction". Two side-by-side sections are labelled "Configuration A" and "Configuration B". Each shows an upper "Accommodation" block, a hatched "Stair" flight bounded by light green stairway walls, and a lower "Accommodation" block, with zig-zag break lines at the edges. In Configuration A a dark green vertical wall stands at the outer edge of the stair, rising into the upper accommodation; in Configuration B the dark green construction appears only as a short horizontal segment at floor level beside the stair. Both configurations carry a vertical dimension "1800mm min." on the upper accommodation and a horizontal dimension "1800mm min." on the stair. A green banner at the bottom reads "Diagram 3.3 External protection to protected stairways".
